title: Youth Congress and NSUI workers show black flags to Union Minister in Shivamogga
seoTitle: Shivamogga protest against Union Minister Somanna

tea.why: Protesting against alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.
tea.want: Demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner over electoral roll revisions.
tea.changed: Oct 12: Police intervened and detained the protesters after they blocked the minister's convoy.

summary: Youth Congress and National Students' Union of India (NSUI) activists staged a demonstration in Shivamogga on Monday, waving black flags at Union Minister of State for Railways and Jal Shakti V. Somanna. The protest occurred near Ashoka Circle on B.H. Road as the minister's convoy was travelling towards a private event. Demonstrators blocked the vehicles to voice opposition against the Centre regarding the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Law enforcement personnel present at the location quickly intervened and took the participants into custody.
demands: Resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner
response: Police personnel present at the scene immediately intervened and detained the protesters.

updates.text: Youth Congress and NSUI workers displayed black flags and blocked Union Minister V. Somanna's convoy in Shivamogga.
Police detained the protesters at the scene near Ashoka Circle on B.H. Road.
